limitations: Post-hoc cause codes describe outcomes; never predictor inputs.
Nonzero density is native-grid-supported exposure, not a matched causative flash or exact within-cell strike.
No pre-issue exposure does not exclude target-day lightning, incomplete detection, spatial/date errors or source outages.
Unknown/mixed causes retained; natural_containing and human_containing overlap and are not an additive partition.
Ranks are global daily ranks; positive-only precision/AP would not answer the question and are not reported.
Pooled and per-year descriptive results reuse development data; no causal explanation or significance claim.

recorded_configuration.overlapping_sensitivity_groups: natural_containing and human_containing include any N/H and can overlap; not summed as a partition
recorded_configuration.exposure: Cached CG density >0; finite zero is detector-zero, not no physical flash. Unknown coverage kept separate. Windows end one hour before local midnight.
recorded_configuration.ranking: All9673cells per local day; descending score, ascending immutable grid_id ties. Midrank=mean of minimum/maximum rank within equal-score tie.
recorded_configuration.capture: Top97/194/484 cells per day. Cohort recall is captured cohort positives / cohort positives; no positive-only precision or reranking.
recorded_configuration.scope: Existing2012--2016 validation predictions only; no fits, no source downloads, no2017--2019 scoring, no cause codes as model inputs
